why: Both land on a pure-drugstore hedgehog measured by profit per customer visit and name the same brutal facts, with Analysis 1 matching the key's "most convenient" wording almost verbatim and warning more directly about chasing store count or new diversification later. Analysis 2 is more decisive on what the key actually required (divest all 25 discount stores and the free-standing restaurant chain rather than pause and "prepare an exit") and gives a sharper, more actionable verdict with explicit tests that would overturn it.
